claims.claim_text: 一篇論文在四台 Apple 機器上，以單一請求解碼的負載測試 KV cache 剪枝、推測解碼、移植的 GPU kernel 與訓練後量化
claims.evidence: Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload.

claims.claim_text: KV cache 剪枝最高讓端到端吞吐量達 1.75 倍，但在桌機 NVIDIA GPU 上可能反而降低
claims.evidence: KV-cache pruning can reach up to 1.75 times end-to-end throughput on Apple; can reduce throughput on desktop NVIDIA GPUs

claims.claim_text: 所有受測的推測解碼方法在 Apple 上都讓吞吐量下降，儘管伺服器 GPU 上的回報是 2 到 6 倍
claims.evidence: all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput on Apple, despite reported 2-6 times gains on server GPUs

claims.claim_text: 作者的結論是，加速倍數取決於技巧、執行環境、硬體與負載的組合，不是技巧本身的屬性
claims.evidence: a reported speedup is not a portable property of a technique alone; a joint function of technique, runtime, hardware contract, and workload regime

claims.claim_text: 約 3 兆參數、共 93 層的 Kimi K3 放上 WSE-3T：dense 層每片晶圓放一層，線性注意力層每片放兩層
claims.evidence: Kimi K3 is an open source, 3T parameter model with 69 linear-attention layers and 24 dense layers; we place one dense layer per wafer and leave the remaining SRAM for its KV cache; room for two linear layers per wafer

claims.claim_text: 合計 35 加 24 共 59 片
claims.evidence: This gives us a total wafer count of 35 + 24 = 59 wafers.

claims.claim_text: 晶圓之間傳的是 activation 而非權重，文章稱每跳約 2 微秒
claims.evidence: Only activations cross from one wafer to the next.; This is roughly 2 microseconds per hop.

claims.claim_text: 每秒 1000 到 2000 以上個 token 的速度是廠商自己的說法，且文章註明比較依賴第三方或內部測試
claims.evidence: multi-trillion parameter models at 1000-2000+ tokens per second; Performance comparisons are based on third-party benchmarking or internal testing.

claims.claim_text: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 的模型卡稱它是原生多模態的 MoE 模型，約 428B 總參數、每個 token 啟用 23B，上下文最長 1,000,000 個 token
claims.evidence: Native multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE); Approximately 428B total; 23B activated per token; Up to 1,000,000 tokens.

claims.claim_text: 卡片同時列出的 Safetensors 中繼資料是 220B，與 428B 對不上
claims.evidence: Safetensors metadata lists 220B params, which conflicts with the 428B figure.

claims.claim_text: 注意力全程採用 MiniMax Sparse Attention，並隨附 DSpark 草稿頭供推測解碼
claims.evidence: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA) throughout the model; DSpark draft head included

claims.claim_text: 卡片的評測表顯示它在 Automation-Bench 與 LOCA-Bench 居首，多數其他列落後，這些都是廠商自己的數字
claims.evidence: Leads Automation-Bench v1.0.6 (62.8) and LOCA-Bench 256K (60.3); ties BankerToolBench 76.2; behind top score in most other rows.

claims.claim_text: uGDS 是開源的使用者空間 GPU Direct Storage 函式庫，主機 CPU 在使用者空間管理 NVMe 命令生命週期，只有一個極小的核心模組負責一次性的特權設定
claims.evidence: an open-source user-space GPU Direct Storage library; host CPU handles NVMe command lifecycle in user space; minimal kernel module is used only for one-time privileged setup.

claims.claim_text: 批次讀取頻寬最高為 GDS 的 12.12 倍、批次寫入最高 30.69 倍（A100 加 Samsung 990 PRO）
claims.evidence: up to 12.12x GDS's batch-read bandwidth; up to 30.69x GDS's batch-write bandwidth; A100 with Samsung 990 PRO SSD

claims.claim_text: 整合 LMCache 後，time-to-first-token 中位數最多降低 62.7%
claims.evidence: uGDS reduces median time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 62.7%.

claims.claim_text: 在 GCC 16.2 的 -O1 下，以 std::unreachable() 結尾的函式會讓從未被呼叫的 explode() 照樣被執行
claims.evidence: Exploding chocolate! The function explode() will be executed, even though it was never called!

claims.claim_text: 把它換成空指標寫入，GCC 輸出寫入 0 再執行 ud2，Clang 則同樣執行 explode()
claims.evidence: First it writes zero, not 99, to memory address zero. Then it crashes the program using an invalid instruction.; Clang also produced the exploding-chocolate output.

claims.claim_text: 作者的重點是編譯器沒有義務偵測未定義行為，結果可以是任何一種
claims.evidence: No compiler is obligated to 'detect' UB at all.

claims.claim_text: wordexp(3) 旗標傳 0 時命令替換預設開啟，$(whoami)/foo 之類的輸入會被執行
claims.evidence: flags of 0 leave all expansion on including command expansion, demonstrated with expand_tilde("$(whoami)/foo", &expanded)

claims.claim_text: WRDE_NOCMD 在部分 libc 實作上很脆弱：musl 先做一次命令替換檢查再交給 shell，部分 Bash 仍視為有效的寫法能繞過
claims.evidence: WRDE_NOCMD is a palliative at best in some libc implementations; musl delegates to the system shell after a basic check for command substitutions that misses some patterns Bash still treats as command substitutions.

claims.claim_text: macOS 的 libc 做法類似，2023 年曾有人回報同類繞過
claims.evidence: Apple's libc works similarly, delegating to wordexp-helper; Julian Squires reported the same bypass in macOS's implementation, as recently as 2023.

claims.claim_text: 建議是別對不可信輸入呼叫 wordexp(3)，即使加上 WRDE_NOCMD 也一樣
claims.evidence: The article advises against using wordexp(3) on untrusted input (round 1: the 'use your own tilde expansion' remedy was not in the source and was deleted from the lede).
claims.note: corrected in fix round 1 (checker round 1 flagged it)

claims.claim_text: Ivan Burmistrov 以他在 Meta 使用 Scuba 的經驗主張，trace、metric 與 log 都是 Wide Event 的特例
claims.evidence: When I was working at Meta ... Traces, Metrics and Logs are all just special cases of Wide Events really.

claims.claim_text: 每筆帶 samplingRate，查詢用 SUM(samplingRate) 取代 COUNT(*)
claims.evidence: a field called samplingRate - the rate this particular event is being sampled with; SELECT SUM(samplingRate) instead of COUNT(*)

claims.claim_text: Scuba 存原始事件、不預先聚合，欄位基數不成問題
claims.evidence: Scuba works with raw events and doesn't pre-aggregate anything, and so cardinality is not an issue.

claims.claim_text: 文章寫於 2024 年 2 月
claims.evidence: Published Feb 15, 2024.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare One 路徑上的 GeoKey Manager 現在用 HPKE，搭配 ML-KEM-768 加 X25519 的混合 KEM，防範先存後解的攻擊
claims.evidence: The Cloudflare One path uses HPKE, as defined in RFC 9180.; KEM combines ML-KEM-768 with X25519; harvest now, decrypt later.
claims.note: corrected in fix round 1 (checker round 1 flagged it)

claims.claim_text: 包裝過的金鑰經 Quicksilver 全球散佈，但只有授權區域的邊緣伺服器拿得到區域根金鑰；任一檢查失敗就拒絕請求
claims.evidence: Quicksilver will then distribute the wrapped private key and metadata across our network.; delivers them only to edge servers authorized for each region; if any required check fails, the request is rejected.

claims.claim_text: 目前是封閉 beta，預計 2027 年第一季全面開放
claims.evidence: in closed beta; general availability (GA) is planned for Q1 2027

claims.claim_text: UTS #39 目前為 18.0.0 版（2026 年 8 月 27 日，Revision 34）
claims.evidence: Version 18.0.0, date 2026-08-27; This Version link points to tr39-34.html

claims.claim_text: 以 skeleton 判定混淆字元，並定義從 ASCII-Only 到 Minimally Restrictive 的五個限制層級，再加上僅供偵測用的 Unrestricted
claims.evidence: skeleton(X) = bidiSkeleton(LTR, X); levels ASCII-Only, Single Script, Highly Restrictive, Moderately Restrictive, Minimally Restrictive, Unrestricted (primarily for use in detection APIs)

claims.claim_text: Astral 宣布 uv 與 ty 的實驗性整合預覽：uv check 準備環境、安裝相依套件並執行 ty，使用 lockfile 中記錄的 ty 版本
claims.evidence: available in preview; uv check will automatically prepare your project's environment, install the required dependencies, and check your project with ty; automatically uses the ty version recorded in your project's lockfile.

claims.claim_text: PEP 723 單檔腳本也會依各自宣告的相依套件與 Python 版本檢查
claims.evidence: Standalone PEP 723 scripts have independent environments and are checked separately.

claims.claim_text: 需要 uv 0.12.3 以上與 ty 0.0.76 以上，自動建環境為選用，因為安裝相依套件可能執行第三方程式碼
claims.evidence: requires uv 0.12.3 or later, and ty 0.0.76 or later; opt-in because dependency installation can require execution of third-party Python code.
